name: Cone-Traced Supersampling
aliases: Cone-Traced Supersampling With Subpixel Edge Reconstruction
definition: An efficient spatial antialiasing solution for SDF rendering that performs supersampling along the traced ray near surfaces with partial visibility (object contours) identified by evaluating cone intersections within a pixel's view frustum.
summary: Cone-Traced Supersampling is an efficient spatial antialiasing technique for SDF rendering that performs supersampling along traced rays near surfaces with partial visibility, avoiding the blurriness of post-processing filters and the cost of additional rays.
